deadline.value: The physics programme and faculty pages fetched give no application deadline; applications go to the faculty.

gre_subject.value: The physics programme pages do not mention the GRE Physics test.

supervisor.value: Before admission you need a pledge of supervision from a professor authorised to examine in the physics doctorate.
supervisor.quote: Pledge of supervision of a person authorised to examine in the doctoral programme in physics for the doctoral project

funding.value: University-wide, the research group or department usually funds doctoral students by contract or scholarship; this is not a guarantee for every applicant.
funding.quote: Usually, the research group or department provides funding to their doctoral students in the form of either an employment contract or a scholarship

entry_route.value: You need a relevant consecutive mathematics or science Master's and at least four years of total study.
entry_route.quote: Completion of a relevant consecutive mathematics/science Master's programme and a total duration of study of at least 4 years

english_waiver.value: If your Master's was taught in English (or German), the physics programme waives the C1 English test; an English-medium Master's from India meets this.
english_waiver.quote: or have completed the Master's degree in an English- or German-language degree programme

notes: Also_fields reflects research areas the programme lists (Astrophysik, Materialphysik). Funding quote is the university-wide Fees and Funding statement. The faculty page says admission is independent of funding and self-funding is possible: 'Die Aufnahme in eines der oben genannten Programme ist unabhängig von der Finanzierung der Promotion.' No GRE or deadline on the physics pages.
